Does this R session own the Julia object behind a handle?

Source: R/julia_handles.R
julia_handle_owned.Rd

Returns FALSE for a handle that arrived by saving and reloading, whose Julia object belongs to the session that created it. It also returns FALSE for a handle created before julia_ready() last set Julia up, whose object went with the old Julia server. Callers use this to tell the user the object came from disk or an earlier session.

Usage

julia_handle_owned(x, state_env)

Arguments

x

A handle from julia_handle().

state_env

The environment given to julia_ready().

Value

TRUE when the current setup of state_env created the handle.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
if (!julia_handle_owned(fit$julia, .my_pkg_env)) {
  stop("This fit was loaded from disk; refit it to continue.")
}
} # }
